column1: # General (Access 2010 and later; sort order 1033 version 1) text index keys written by ACE 16.0 (DAO.DBEngine.120) into a copy of the corpus's common1V2010.accdb, an Access 2010 database in that order,
# ascending (7F...) and descending (80...). One value per line: its code points in hex, then the two
# keys. Made by tools/ace-text-keys.ps1, which has the engine index each value and reads the index pages back.
